summary: Two-player tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 board. One append-only row per move; the board is replayed from the rows and whose turn it is follows from the move count.

props.name: Game
props.note: Bump this for a new game; the board replays the highest Game only.

notes: Append-only: a move is a new row, never an edit of a board cell, so two players cannot overwrite each other.
Seat claims live in artifact.state (seat.X / seat.O) because they are room state, not moves. A seat is a convenience, not enforcement: anyone can add a row in a table view.

Whose turn it is = move count of the current game, and the MARK follows the same rule: the replay assigns X on even moves and O on odd, and skips a row whose Seat disagrees. A row claiming the wrong seat is therefore ignored rather than drawn out of turn.
Moves replay in the snapshot's own order, which is the rows' insertion order. Do not sort by row id: ids begin with the writing client's clock, so skew would decide who reached a square first.
An agent player writes its moves as rows in the same shape.
